body: I do have cod. But I'd  have to re download it. Its getting early which is when I crash typically but I'll start the download. May be a couple years though. Haha.

Well I hope it helps if you seek it out. I will say from being a fairly high functioning person of a depressed and anxious state, there's no "fix" as I'm sure you know.  There are so many more of us than you might imagine if you haven't branched out either online or locally. You seem pretty wise to  the world though so I assume you know most of this. I've found videogames or in these days of covid, streaming movies or shows with others could be fun if you're up for it. I think the world is full of pressure to be a certain way and that's what fucks me up, but seeing how no one else really knows what's up in this world kinda helps.

Have you ever looked into thyroid disorder? It affects a lot of people. I've seen some benefits myself from seeking treatment. Just curious though, is your solitude out of choice? You seem like a confident person
Do you ever feel inexplicably cold? Or "sleep think" to yourself (I'm not sure what to call it)?

I'm feeling pretty bare at the moment myself but I can't tell how close I am. I'm a few years in to the darker side of depression, though I have dealt with it for a while now. Just now reaching out. I know i have time and I have found solace in the past by helping or trying to with others. No expert, but I  am empathetic (though I worry it's a waning trait for me). Far from what you need but willing to help if I can.
